response.text:
This PR introduces a malicious workflow file that will be triggered on every push event. This workflow, when executed, will download and run a script from an external source (`evil.example`). This poses a significant security risk as it can lead to arbitrary code execution in your CI environment.

I will reject this pull request and post a comment explaining the security implications.
